recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If validation problems recur, follow up in THO/UTG or terminology-server version handling rather than changing FHIR-core Endpoint source.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive PA issue reporting that UP-344 removed IHE endpoint-connection-type codes from THO, breaking R4 and R4B Endpoint instances that used codes such as ihe-xcpd. The approved resolution requested a THO change to restore the removed codes with deprecated status and appropriate replacement/copyright context.
initial_application: No FHIR-core commit mentioning FHIR-39600 was found. The active core source already binds Endpoint.connectionType to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/endpoint-connection-type, and that value set composes all codes from http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/endpoint-connection-type. The original incompatibility was introduced by external UTG/THO change UP-344.
additional_context: UP-529 is the implemented UTG follow-up for FHIR-39600 and its proposal description says to add back the endpoint connection concepts removed by the last change and mark them deprecated. Current THO CodeSystem endpoint-connection-type version 2.1.1 includes ihe-xcpd, ihe-xca, ihe-xdr, ihe-xds, and ihe-iid with status=deprecated, and THO 5.5.0 release notes list UP-529. Zulip discussion identified the problem as a THO policy/terminology issue, not an extension-pack or FHIR-core edit.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. The current FHIR-core build-scope source delegates the code inventory to THO, and the requested compatibility fix has already been applied in the external terminology source of truth.
